---
title: "Stage 3b: Time Controls and a Positional Prior"
output: html_document
---

Results come from the pipeline (`targets::tar_make()` in the project root);
this report only reads and displays them. The models run on segments (exact
score), with game state as score difference x six 15-minute bins. M4 adds
counts of each position group on the pitch, unpenalized, so each player's
effect is a deviation from his position's mean.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Run from the project root whether knit by tar_make() or by the Knit button
root <- normalizePath(if (file.exists("_targets.R")) "." else "..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
tar_source()
```

```{r read}
cv3b <- tar_read(cv3b)
positions <- tar_read(positions)
seg_mins <- tar_read(seg_mins)
```

## 1. Data and likelihood

```{r data}
segment_table <- tar_read(segment_table)
cat(sprintf("Segment rows: %d | Game-state cells: %d\n", nrow(segment_table),
            nlevels(add_game_state(segment_table, "score_time")$game_state)))
regular <- seg_mins$player_id[seg_mins$minutes >= IDENT_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD]
show_table(as.data.frame(table(`Position group` = positions$group[positions$player_id %in% regular],
                               useNA = "ifany"), responseName = "Players"))
show_table(family_table(tar_read(fam3b)))
show_table(tar_read(sanity3b))
```

## 2. Cross-validation, all models

```{r cv}
show_table(cv_table(cv3b))
```

```{r cv-curve, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
plot_cv_curve(cv3b)
```

## 3. Reliability, M3 vs M4

```{r reliability}
show_table(rbind(reliability_table(tar_read(split_half3b_m3)),
                 reliability_table(tar_read(split_half3b_m4))))
```

## 4. Position effects, with and without time controls

One more player of the group in place of a midfielder, % shots per 90, with
delete-one-fold jackknife SEs. Offense: positive means more shots taken.
Defense: positive means more shots conceded. Both use M4's prior SD. If the
effects shrink once time remaining is controlled, they were mostly
substitution timing.

```{r positions}
position_fx <- tar_read(position_fx)
show_table(position_comparison_table(position_fx$score, position_fx$score_time))
```
